verdict.rationale: Stripe's Terminal testing docs say the SDKs and the server-driven integration include a built-in simulated card reader. Developers can build and test without physical hardware, and the docs explicitly recommend testing with the reader simulator before ordering a reader. missing for 10: documentation of simulated test cards or test-mode payment outcomes (declines, errors) for in-person flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end simulator testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live

citations.quote: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Before ordering a reader, test your integration with the reader simulator.
